nodes.name: Isis
nodes.domain: Throne goddess, mother goddess, magic, wisdom, rebirth
nodes.characterTrait: Combines Good and Terrible Mother aspects; nurturing yet powerful
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Depicted with throne headdress, cow horns with sun disk (as Isis-Hathor)
nodes.significantEvent: Resurrects Osiris; mother of Horus; her name means 'seat/throne'
nodes.symbolism: Throne as 'seat' - the mother is the throne that makes the king; combines features of Terrible and Good Mother; Stella Maris (Star of the Sea)
nodes.neumannArchetype: Central archetype combining Terrible and Good Mother. Corresponds to the full Great Mother archetype.

nodes.name: Demeter
nodes.domain: Agriculture, harvest, fertility, Eleusinian mysteries, earth mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Mature woman with grain or torch
nodes.significantEvent: Loss and recovery of daughter Kore/Persephone; Eleusinian mysteries; Thesmophoria festival with pig sacrifice
nodes.symbolism: Positive Mother pole (M+); goddess of grain and harvest; pig sacrificed in Thesmophoria; mourning represents death/rebirth cycle of vegetation
nodes.neumannArchetype: Occupies the positive M pole. Mother figure of the Eleusinian mysteries.

nodes.name: Sophia
nodes.domain: Wisdom, spiritual transformation, Good Mother archetype
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Radiant, associated with light and wisdom
nodes.significantEvent: Projection of the Good Mother archetype; Sophia-virgin as positive anima
nodes.symbolism: Good Mother projection; positive anima figure; represents wisdom and spiritual transformation; counterpart to Gorgon
nodes.neumannArchetype: Represents the Good Mother projection, the positive pole of the Archetypal Feminine.

nodes.name: Kore
nodes.domain: Spring, underworld, maiden, vegetation rebirth
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Young maiden, nearly identical in appearance to mother Demeter
nodes.significantEvent: Abduction to underworld; Demeter-Kore mysteries of Eleusis
nodes.symbolism: Daughter and partial figure of Demeter; mother-daughter genealogy; 'full grown and almost identical with her virgin-mother Demeter'
nodes.neumannArchetype: Daughter and partial figure of Demeter. The Demeter-Kore relationship represents the mother-daughter unity.

nodes.name: Uroboros
nodes.domain: Primordial unity, self-containment, origin of opposites
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Circular snake biting its own tail
nodes.significantEvent: Symbol of psychic state of the beginning; contains all opposites
nodes.symbolism: Great Round; symbol of psychic origin; contains masculine and feminine; precedes differentiation into archetypes
nodes.neumannArchetype: The 'Great Round' preceding all differentiation. Contains both masculine and feminine.

nodes.name: Osiris
nodes.domain: Underworld, death-rebirth, agriculture, judgment
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Mummy-wrapped; green-skinned
nodes.significantEvent: Embraced by cedar tree; djed pillar as coffin; religion of Osiris and Horus promises rebirth to all souls
nodes.symbolism: Djed pillar is both phallic-masculine and containing-feminine; cedar tree embraces corpse as earth-womb; promises universal rebirth
nodes.neumannArchetype: His djed pillar is both masculine and feminine-containing. The cedar tree embracing his corpse represents the earth-womb.

nodes.name: Tiamat
nodes.domain: Primordial chaos, ocean, mother of gods, fate
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Dragon/serpent form; open gullet
nodes.significantEvent: Defeated by Marduk; body split to form heaven and earth; 'mother of the gods and possessor of the table of fate'
nodes.symbolism: Male-female uroboric unity with Apsu; primordial chaos of water; mother of all gods; split body becomes heaven and earth
nodes.neumannArchetype: Key example of the uroboric Great Mother. Constitutes primordial male-female unity with Apsu.

nodes.name: Gorgon
nodes.domain: Terror, death, underworld, Terrible Mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Snakes writhing round her head; petrifying gaze that turns men to stone
nodes.significantEvent: Turns men to stone with her gaze; projection of the Terrible Mother
nodes.symbolism: Terrible Mother projection; terrifying aspect of the unconscious feminine; snake-haired; at negative pole M-
nodes.neumannArchetype: Projection of the Terrible Mother, representing the negative pole of the Great Mother archetype.

nodes.name: Hathor
nodes.domain: Sky, motherhood, joy, music, nurturing, cow of heaven
nodes.characterTrait: Nurturing, maternal, joyful but also terrible
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Cow-headed or cow-horned headdress; maternal symbols
nodes.significantEvent: Ritual baring before grieving Demeter parallel; nurturing cow of heaven; Isis-Hathor fusion
nodes.symbolism: Nurturing cow of heaven; horns as maternal symbols; fused with Isis as Isis-Hathor; cow-heaven mother
nodes.neumannArchetype: The nurturing cow of heaven. Associated with both terrible and positive aspects. Fused with Isis.

nodes.name: Nut
nodes.domain: Sky, celestial vessel, rebirth, death and resurrection
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Arched body forming the sky; depicted on sarcophagi embracing the dead
nodes.significantEvent: Embraces the dead on sarcophagi for rebirth; heavenly cow who waters earth with rain-milk
nodes.symbolism: Celestial goddess; symbol of femininity; Lady of Heaven; goddess of rebirth but also death as Nuit
nodes.neumannArchetype: Celestial vessel-goddess. 'Goddess of rebirth, but she also has the character of death as Nuit.'

nodes.name: Artemis
nodes.domain: Hunt, wilderness, moon, virginity, Great Goddess
nodes.characterTrait: Virginal yet all-encompassing as Great Goddess
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Huntress; as Diana of Ephesus: many-breasted
nodes.significantEvent: As Great Goddess, includes attributes of all poles; Hecate-Artemis cult
nodes.symbolism: Virginal pole but also Great Goddess including all attributes; Lady of the Beasts
nodes.neumannArchetype: As Great Goddess, includes attributes of all poles. The non-Greek Artemis is broader than the classical virginal version.

nodes.name: Madonna
nodes.domain: Mother of God, salvation, mercy, Stella Maris
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Sits on lion-adorned throne; sometimes depicted spinning
nodes.significantEvent: Pieta (holding dead Jesus); Stella Maris (Star of the Sea); spinner of fate
nodes.symbolism: Stella Maris paralleling Isis and Tara; Pieta as mother of death; Christian continuation of Great Mother; spinner of fate
nodes.neumannArchetype: Christian continuation of Great Mother archetype. Stella Maris paralleling Isis and Tara.

nodes.name: Lady of the Beasts
nodes.domain: Animals, wilderness, hunting, Great Goddess
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Flanked by animals (Potnia Theron)
nodes.significantEvent: Ancient Great Goddess form; Circe as Lady of the Beasts in Odyssey
nodes.symbolism: Primordial Great Goddess form; sovereign over all animals; Potnia Theron
nodes.neumannArchetype: Ancient form of the Great Goddess. Circe identified as Lady of the Beasts.

nodes.name: Quetzalcoatl
nodes.domain: Life, light, wisdom, wind, morning star, spiritual transformation
nodes.characterTrait: Spiritual hero, self-transforming rather than world-transforming
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Plumed serpent; head upraised
nodes.significantEvent: Inner spiritual transformation; identical with morning star; god of winds; son deity
nodes.symbolism: Name combines quetzalli 'tail feather' and coatl 'serpent'; highest form of spiritual hero myth; inner transformation
nodes.neumannArchetype: Highest form of the hero myth achieving spiritual self-transformation.

nodes.name: Odin
nodes.domain: Wisdom, fate, death, war, poetry, runes
nodes.significantEvent: Hanging from Yggdrasil; takes wisdom from volvas (seeresses); relation to Mimir's spring
nodes.symbolism: Bond with spring of fate; judgment seat at world ash tree; takes wisdom from feminine seeresses
nodes.neumannArchetype: Takes wisdom from feminine seeresses. His hanging from Yggdrasil reflects relation to tree of fate.

nodes.name: Hecate
nodes.domain: Witchcraft, crossroads, underworld, moon, Terrible Mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Triple-formed; genital-exposing posture (theriomorphic)
nodes.significantEvent: Hecate-Artemis cult; associated with underworld and dead
nodes.symbolism: Terrible Mother at negative pole M-; Hecate-Artemis fusion shows range of Great Goddess
nodes.neumannArchetype: At the negative pole of the Great Mother. Along with Kali and Gorgon, represents the Terrible Mother.

nodes.name: Ra
nodes.domain: Sun, creation, cosmic order
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Falcon-headed with sun disk
nodes.significantEvent: Born from Neith without father; son of heavenly cow goddess; Ammon-Ra as creator
nodes.symbolism: Sun god born from self-generating mother Neith; endangered son protected by cow goddess recitations
nodes.neumannArchetype: Born from self-generating mother. The heavenly cow goddess composed recitations for her endangered son Ra.

nodes.name: Tara
nodes.domain: Salvation, compassion, navigation, Great Good Goddess
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Rides on lion; holds sun in hand
nodes.significantEvent: 'Mistress of boats, capable of pacifying the watery flood'; savioress; 'the wise worship me as Tara'
nodes.symbolism: Great Good Goddess; Stella Maris parallel to Madonna and Isis; 'redeeming one' (Tarini)
nodes.neumannArchetype: Great Good Goddess paralleling Madonna and Isis as Stella Maris.

nodes.name: Venus
nodes.domain: Fertility, femininity, love, Great Mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Exaggerated feminine features (Paleolithic Venus figurines); Venus of Willendorf
nodes.significantEvent: Venus of Willendorf; Lespugne Venus; earliest Great Mother representations
nodes.symbolism: Paleolithic fertility figurines; exaggerated hips, breasts, belly; earliest known Great Mother representations
nodes.neumannArchetype: Earliest prehistoric representations of the Great Mother archetype (Venus figurines).

nodes.name: Norns
nodes.domain: Fate, destiny, time (past/present/future)
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Three women: Urth, Verthandi, Skuld
nodes.significantEvent: Spin and twist thread of fate; third breaks it off; shape hero's fate at night
nodes.symbolism: Triple fate goddesses; spinning and breaking thread of destiny; past-present-future; birth-life-death
nodes.neumannArchetype: Two spin and twist thread, third breaks it off. Represent beginning-middle-end, past-present-future.

nodes.name: Ishtar
nodes.domain: Love, war, fertility, Great Goddess, creatress
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: With branches or ears of grain
nodes.significantEvent: Descent to underworld; terrible and positive aspects
nodes.symbolism: Great Goddess combining terrible and positive; creatress as potter (Mama/Aruru); with branches/ears of grain
nodes.neumannArchetype: Both terrible and positive. At negative pole as terrible Ishtar, but also Great Goddess encompassing multiple aspects.

nodes.name: Dionysus
nodes.domain: Wine, ecstasy, frenzy, vegetation, death-rebirth
nodes.significantEvent: Opposition and reconciliation with Apollo at Delphi; relation of women to Dionysus
nodes.symbolism: Ecstatic-matriarchal realm; relationship with women; opposition to Apollo is 'superficial'
nodes.neumannArchetype: Exemplifies the ecstatic-matriarchal world. His relationship with women explored.

nodes.name: Horus
nodes.domain: Sky, kingship, sun, falcon
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Falcon-headed or infant
nodes.significantEvent: Son of Isis; infant nursed by mother; king through the mother
nodes.symbolism: Divine child of the Great Mother; 'through whom alone he is king'; divine child archetype
nodes.neumannArchetype: Son of Isis. The king is Horus through the mother. Represents the divine child archetype.

nodes.name: Kali
nodes.domain: Destruction, time, death, dark mother, blood sacrifice
nodes.object: Skulls, severed heads and hands, necklace of skulls
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Many arms, dark-skinned, stands on corpse of Shiva, adorned with skulls
nodes.significantEvent: Blood sacrifices at Kalighat (Calcutta); ~800 goats sacrificed at Durgapuja
nodes.symbolism: Terrible Mother archetype; 'dark, all-devouring time'; stands on Shiva's corpse; devouring feminine
nodes.neumannArchetype: Primary example of the Terrible Mother. 'Dark, all-devouring time.' Stands on Shiva's corpse.

nodes.name: Aphrodite
nodes.domain: Love, beauty, seduction, war (in Sparta/Cyprus)
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Golden, beautiful
nodes.significantEvent: Also goddess of war in Sparta and Cyprus; enchants and ruins men
nodes.symbolism: Golden Aphrodite who 'enchants and ruins men'; war aspect; Circe as Aphroditelike
nodes.neumannArchetype: Seductive enchantress. Also has war aspect. Connected to Circe as 'Aphroditelike.'

nodes.name: Maya
nodes.domain: Illusion, world-appearance, fate, cosmic deception
nodes.significantEvent: World as Maya/illusion; as Heimarmene/fate; as monster or witch
nodes.symbolism: Cosmic illusion; world as hell or Maya; fate as Heimarmene; goddess as the Maya, 'the great...'
nodes.neumannArchetype: The goddess as Maya, cosmic illusion and fate.

nodes.name: Eve
nodes.domain: Life, origin, fall, mother of humanity
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Naked; belly is life
nodes.significantEvent: Taken from Adam (unnatural symbol); Jewish life-affirming aspect
nodes.symbolism: Unnatural origin from Adam reverses natural birth; 'the naked Eve. Her belly is life'; resembles Astarte and Gaea
nodes.neumannArchetype: Her origin from Adam is an 'unnatural symbol.' In Jewish aspect, life-affirming.

nodes.name: Huitzilopochtli
nodes.domain: War, sun, human sacrifice
nodes.significantEvent: Son of Coatlicue; Aztec war/sun god requiring human sacrifice
nodes.symbolism: Hero god of the Aztecs; son of earth mother Coatlicue; sun warrior deity
nodes.neumannArchetype: Aztec hero/war god, son of Coatlicue the earth mother.

nodes.name: Sphinx
nodes.domain: Riddles, death, guardian, Terrible Mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Lion body, woman's head, wings; veiled sphinx of Tell Halaf
nodes.significantEvent: Kills herself when Oedipus solves riddle; veiled sphinx of Tell Halaf with penetrating eyes
nodes.symbolism: Kills herself rather than be defeated; same penetrating eyes as alabaster goddess; guardian figure
nodes.neumannArchetype: Does not kill herself like defeated figure, but continues. Veiled sphinx with penetrating eyes.

nodes.name: Mary
nodes.domain: Mother of God, heaven, fire, feminine principles
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Goes under robe; associated with Holy Ghost
nodes.significantEvent: Heaven goes under robe of Mary; upper and lower feminine principles kindled
nodes.symbolism: Upper and lower feminine principles; Holy Ghost connection; continuation of Great Mother in Christianity
nodes.neumannArchetype: Christian continuation of the Great Mother. Upper and lower feminine principles kindled through Mary.

nodes.name: Nekhbet
nodes.domain: Upper Egypt, motherhood, death/rebirth, vulture goddess
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Vulture form; white-crowned
nodes.significantEvent: Vulture goddess of south; Great Goddess of Upper Egypt
nodes.symbolism: Vulture symbolizes death and rebirth; 'white-crowned Great Goddess of Upper Egypt'
nodes.neumannArchetype: Vulture goddess symbolizing death and rebirth. Great Goddess of Upper Egypt.

nodes.name: Persephone
nodes.domain: Underworld, spring, vegetation rebirth
nodes.significantEvent: Same relation to corn mother as grain to earth; Eleusis mysteries
nodes.symbolism: Relation to corn mother as seed to earth; associated with Demeter, Artemis; maiden becoming queen of death
nodes.neumannArchetype: Stands in same relation to corn mother as seed to earth.

nodes.name: Mayauel
nodes.domain: Maguey plant, intoxication, nourishment, fertility
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: 400 breasts
nodes.significantEvent: Goddess of intoxicant from maguey; Mexican Great Goddess
nodes.symbolism: 400 breasts = superabundant nourishment; stars in celestial ocean; parallel to Diana of Ephesus
nodes.neumannArchetype: Mexican Great Goddess with 400 breasts, symbolizing superabundant nourishment.

nodes.name: Hel
nodes.domain: Underworld, death, realm of the dead
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Half alive, half dead (half-decomposed)
nodes.significantEvent: Rules the Norse underworld
nodes.symbolism: Terrible Mother as ruler of the dead; Norse underworld goddess
nodes.neumannArchetype: Norse death goddess representing the Terrible Mother as ruler of the underworld.

nodes.name: Adonis
nodes.domain: Vegetation, beauty, death-rebirth
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Beautiful young prince of flowers
nodes.significantEvent: Born from tree; mourned with breast-beating; seed grain symbolism
nodes.symbolism: Born from tree like vegetation gods; ritual breast-beating mourning; seed grain taken to underworld and reborn
nodes.neumannArchetype: Born from tree. Mourned with ritual breast-beating. Represents vegetation death-rebirth cycle.

nodes.name: Gaea
nodes.domain: Earth, primordial mother
nodes.significantEvent: Linked with Eve and Astarte as earth mother figure
nodes.symbolism: Earth mother; primordial feminine; linked to Eve and Astarte
nodes.neumannArchetype: Earth mother figure linked with Eve and Astarte.

nodes.name: Diana of Ephesus
nodes.domain: Fertility, nature, Great Mother, many-breasted nourishment
nodes.object: Many breasts, robe with beasts of zodiac
nodes.animals: beasts of the zodiac on robe and crown
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Many-breasted; robe and crown adorned with zodiac beasts
nodes.significantEvent: Classical form of the Great Goddess of nourishment
nodes.symbolism: Classical form of the nourishing Great Goddess; cosmic nourishment through zodiac beast adornment
nodes.neumannArchetype: Classical form of the Great Goddess. Many breasts and zodiac beast adornment represent cosmic nourishment.

nodes.name: Neith
nodes.domain: War, weaving, creation, primordial mother
nodes.significantEvent: Brought forth son Ra without husband; part of quaternary with Hathor, Bast
nodes.symbolism: Unitary world of the Archetypal Feminine; self-generating mother; bore Ra without male aid
nodes.neumannArchetype: Represents the unitary world of the Archetypal Feminine. Self-generating.

nodes.name: Apollo
nodes.domain: Sun, music, prophecy, reason, order
nodes.significantEvent: Opposition to Dionysus at Delphi; Pythian Apollo
nodes.symbolism: Opposition to Dionysus is 'superficial'; Delphi reconciliation; Pythian Apollo vs. ecstatic realm
nodes.neumannArchetype: Opposition to Dionysus at Delphi is 'superficial.' Reconciliation of both at Delphi.

nodes.name: Marduk
nodes.domain: Sun, creation, kingship, storm
nodes.significantEvent: Defeats Tiamat; creates heaven and earth from her body
nodes.symbolism: Patriarchal sun god who defeats uroboric mother; creates ordered world from chaos
nodes.neumannArchetype: Patriarchal sun god who defeats Tiamat, splitting her body to create heaven and earth.

nodes.name: Bast
nodes.domain: Cats, protection, joy, home
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Cat-headed
nodes.significantEvent: Part of quaternary with Hathor, Neith
nodes.symbolism: Part of Egyptian goddess quaternary; paired with Neith
nodes.neumannArchetype: Part of the quaternary with Hathor and Neith in the Archetypal Feminine.

nodes.name: Circe
nodes.domain: Enchantment, sorcery, transformation, nature
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Aphroditelike
nodes.significantEvent: Enchantress who transforms men; 'always subject to defeat'; Lady of the Beasts in Odyssey
nodes.symbolism: Personalized form of primordial enchantment; figure 'always subject to defeat'; Lady of the Beasts
nodes.neumannArchetype: Enchantress figure 'always subject to defeat.' Aphroditelike Circe is also the Lady of the Beasts.

nodes.name: Cybele
nodes.domain: Mother of gods, earth, wild nature, mountains
nodes.significantEvent: Stone of Pessinus moved to Rome; strangled victims as Gorgon
nodes.symbolism: Mother Goddess who 'strangled them as Gorgon, as Cybele'; stone cult; from Pessinus to Rome
nodes.neumannArchetype: Mother Goddess who 'strangled them as Gorgon, as Cybele.'

nodes.name: Zeus
nodes.domain: Sky, thunder, kingship, cosmic order
nodes.significantEvent: Newborn Zeus fed with honey; realms shared by sons Zeus, Poseidon, Hades
nodes.symbolism: Fed with honey as newborn; purest product of organic nature; shared mother's realms with brothers
nodes.neumannArchetype: Newborn Zeus fed with honey. Shared the Great Mother's realms with his brothers.

nodes.name: Ceres
nodes.domain: Agriculture, grain, fertility
nodes.significantEvent: Ceres-Spes (Hope) association; bee symbolism; Cretan Great Goddess connection
nodes.symbolism: Ceres-Spes (Hope); bee association with moon; Cretan Great Goddess; Demeter parallel
nodes.neumannArchetype: Roman Demeter. Associated with Spes (Hope) and the Cretan Great Goddess.

nodes.name: Astarte
nodes.domain: Love, war, fertility, Great Goddess
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: 'Astarte type' with hands on breasts
nodes.significantEvent: Widely distributed 'Astarte type'; figure resembling Eve, Astarte, and Gaea
nodes.symbolism: Fatal enchantment; 'Astarte type' with hands on breasts; linked to Eve and Gaea
nodes.neumannArchetype: Figure of fatal enchantment. The widely distributed 'Astarte type.'

nodes.name: Baubo
nodes.domain: Belly/body humor, fertility, ritual obscenity
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Belly goddess; body displayed as face (Priene figurines)
nodes.significantEvent: Bares herself before grieving Demeter; Priene figurines
nodes.symbolism: Belly character of the woman; ritual baring/obscenity as life-affirming; belly as face
nodes.neumannArchetype: 'The belly character of the woman' is prominent. Bares herself before grieving Demeter.

nodes.name: Hermes
nodes.domain: Messengers, boundaries, travelers, psychopomp
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Winged sandals, winged helmet
nodes.significantEvent: Hermes as soul-guide; snake-entwined healing staff of Hermes and Asclepius
nodes.symbolism: Soul-guide (Seelenfuhrer); snake-entwined healing staff; guides between worlds
nodes.neumannArchetype: Soul-guide. Snake-entwined healing staff of Hermes and Asclepius.

nodes.name: Shiva
nodes.domain: Destruction, transformation, meditation, dance
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Third eye, ash-covered body
nodes.significantEvent: Kali stands on Shiva's corpse; Shiva or Shakti contained in double symbol; 'the imperturbable'
nodes.symbolism: Kali stands on his corpse; 'double symbol in which Shiva or Shakti is contained'; 'the imperturbable'
nodes.neumannArchetype: Kali stands on his corpse. 'The imperturbable' contained within Shakti.

nodes.name: Scylla
nodes.domain: Sea monster, devouring, death
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Multi-headed sea monster
nodes.significantEvent: Mother Krataiis connected to nether world
nodes.symbolism: Devouring female figure; alluring and death-dealing; mother connected to underworld
nodes.neumannArchetype: Among 'alluring and death-dealing female figures.' Mother connected to nether world.

nodes.name: Eumenides
nodes.domain: Vengeance, justice, underworld
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Snake-haired
nodes.significantEvent: Called 'sisters' by Aeschylus; grove at Sicyon; earth offerings
nodes.symbolism: Erinyes/Eumenides; 'sisters' per Aeschylus; earth-connected; earth offerings characteristic of earth goddesses
nodes.neumannArchetype: Aeschylus designates as 'sisters.' Receive offerings characteristic of earth goddesses.

nodes.name: Valkyrie
nodes.domain: War, death, fate of warriors
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Armed warrior maiden
nodes.significantEvent: Choose the slain; associated with waelcyrge
nodes.symbolism: Death-bringing feminine warrior; waelcyrge (chooser of the slain); associated with ravens and fate
nodes.neumannArchetype: Death-bringing feminine warrior. Waelcyrge (chooser of slain) connects to fate.

nodes.name: Medusa
nodes.domain: Terror, petrification, death
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Snake hair, petrifying gaze
nodes.significantEvent: Petrifying gaze; killed by Perseus
nodes.symbolism: Petrifying gaze belongs to 'province of the Terrible Mother'
nodes.neumannArchetype: Petrifying gaze belongs to the province of the Terrible Mother.

nodes.name: Durga
nodes.domain: War, protection, invincibility, Terrible Mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Many arms holding weapons
nodes.significantEvent: Durgapuja festival with ~800 goat sacrifices; name means 'Unapproachable'
nodes.symbolism: The 'Unapproachable' and 'Perilous'; Indian Terrible Mother; blood sacrifice
nodes.neumannArchetype: The 'Unapproachable' and 'Perilous.' Indian Terrible Mother requiring blood sacrifice.

nodes.name: Lilith
nodes.domain: Night, evil, death, seduction
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Winged
nodes.significantEvent: Mesopotamian goddess of night, evil, death
nodes.symbolism: Specter figure; 'Mesopotamian goddess Lilith of night, evil, and death, winged'
nodes.neumannArchetype: Specter figure. Mesopotamian goddess of night, evil, and death.

nodes.name: Maat
nodes.domain: Justice, truth, cosmic order
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Feather on head
nodes.significantEvent: Correlated with Sophia-Wisdom at positive pole
nodes.symbolism: Justice and cosmic order; correlated with Sophia-Wisdom and Kore
nodes.neumannArchetype: Egyptian goddess of justice correlated with Sophia-Wisdom at the positive pole.

nodes.name: Tlazolteotl
nodes.domain: Filth, purification, earth, sexuality, childbirth
nodes.significantEvent: Earth goddess of sexuality and purification
nodes.symbolism: Mexican earth/purification goddess; transformation aspect of the Great Mother
nodes.neumannArchetype: Mexican goddess associated with the earth and transformation.

nodes.name: Xochiquetzal
nodes.domain: Flowers, beauty, love, crafts, fertility
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Flower-adorned
nodes.significantEvent: Mexican goddess of beauty and flowers
nodes.symbolism: Mexican flower goddess; beauty and fertility of the Great Mother
nodes.neumannArchetype: Mexican goddess representing the positive, beautiful aspect of the feminine.

nodes.name: Selene
nodes.domain: Moon
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Radiant, moon-crowned
nodes.significantEvent: Listed among aspects of the Great Goddess
nodes.symbolism: Moon goddess; aspect of the Great Goddess
nodes.neumannArchetype: Listed alongside Persephone, Medusa as aspect of the Great Goddess.

nodes.name: Eileithyia
nodes.domain: Childbirth
nodes.significantEvent: Goddess presiding over childbirth
nodes.symbolism: Birth goddess; generative power of the Great Mother
nodes.neumannArchetype: Birth goddess representing the generative aspect of the Great Mother.

nodes.name: Asherah
nodes.domain: Motherhood, sea, sacred trees/poles
nodes.significantEvent: Asherah pole as symbol of Great Mother
nodes.symbolism: Sacred pillar/pole as symbol of Great Mother; tree/pillar feminine symbolism
nodes.neumannArchetype: The asherah pillar is a symbol of the Great Mother.

nodes.name: Chicomecoatl
nodes.domain: Corn, agriculture, sustenance
nodes.significantEvent: Mexican corn goddess; 'Seven Serpent'
nodes.symbolism: Mexican corn/vegetation goddess; nourishing aspect of the Great Mother
nodes.neumannArchetype: Mexican corn goddess representing the nourishing vegetation aspect.

nodes.name: Kwan-yin
nodes.domain: Compassion, mercy, salvation
nodes.significantEvent: Listed with Isis, Demeter, Artemis, Ishtar as Great Goddess forms
nodes.symbolism: Buddhist compassion goddess; Chinese Great Goddess paralleling Isis and Demeter
nodes.neumannArchetype: Listed alongside Isis, Demeter, Artemis as forms of the positive Great Mother.

nodes.name: Britomartis
nodes.domain: Mountains, hunting, fishing nets
nodes.significantEvent: Cretan goddess; associated with Dictynna
nodes.symbolism: Cretan goddess paired with Dictynna; aspect of the Great Goddess
nodes.neumannArchetype: Listed alongside Dictynna as aspect of the Great Goddess.

nodes.name: Dictynna
nodes.domain: Hunting, nets, mountains
nodes.significantEvent: Paired with Britomartis as Cretan goddess
nodes.symbolism: Cretan goddess paired with Britomartis
nodes.neumannArchetype: Paired with Britomartis. Among many names of the Great Goddess.

nodes.name: Tammuz
nodes.domain: Vegetation, shepherds, death-rebirth
nodes.significantEvent: Descent to underworld; mourned by Ishtar/Inanna
nodes.symbolism: Dying-and-rising vegetation god; paired with Ishtar/Inanna
nodes.neumannArchetype: Dying-and-rising god paired with Ishtar.

nodes.name: Shakti
nodes.domain: Cosmic energy, divine feminine power
nodes.significantEvent: Contained within Shiva; cosmic feminine principle
nodes.symbolism: Divine feminine power; 'double symbol in which Shiva or Shakti is contained'
nodes.neumannArchetype: 'Double symbol in which Shiva or Shakti is contained.' Cosmic feminine principle.

nodes.name: Coatlicue
nodes.domain: Earth, death, creation, Terrible Mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Snake robe/skirt ('she of the serpent skirt')
nodes.significantEvent: Mother of Huitzilopochtli; Mexican Terrible Mother
nodes.symbolism: Mexican snake goddess; Terrible Mother; earth combining creation and death
nodes.neumannArchetype: Mexican snake goddess representing the Terrible Mother.

nodes.name: Rangda
nodes.domain: Witchcraft, death, evil, Terrible Mother
nodes.physicalCharacteristics: Witch figure with long hair and fangs
nodes.significantEvent: Balinese witch representing the Terrible Mother
nodes.symbolism: Balinese Terrible Mother/witch archetype
nodes.neumannArchetype: Balinese witch representing the Terrible Mother archetype.

nodes.name: Inanna
nodes.domain: Love, war, fertility, heaven, underworld descent
nodes.significantEvent: Descent to underworld; Sumerian precursor to Ishtar
nodes.symbolism: Sumerian Great Goddess; precursor to Ishtar
nodes.neumannArchetype: Sumerian precursor to Babylonian Ishtar.
